title: FTTH GPON Rollout, Residential Township
summary: GPON FTTH deployment for 2,400 homes covering splicing, OTDR testing, FAT installation and OLT integration.
description: End to end FTTH build for a residential township project, from the splitter cabinets at the OLT down to the in home ONUs. Our crews handled the entire passive network, including FDBs, FATs and drop fibre installation, with OTDR traces for every spliced span.

title: NLD Fibre Backbone, Inter City Span
summary: 120 km National Long Distance backbone with HDD river crossings, manhole infrastructure and full OTDR characterisation.
description: Long span NLD backbone deployment with multiple HDD crossings under rivers and highways. Civil, splicing and testing handled by our in house teams, with detailed as built documentation for the operator.

title: Right of Way Programme, State Highway
summary: Full ROW liaison and approvals for a 90 km route across NHAI, PWD and municipal jurisdictions, with no programme delay.
description: A 90 km route involves a long list of authorities. We managed every application, every site visit and every restoration sign off so that the operator could focus on the build rather than the paperwork.

title: Tier III Data Centre Cabling, Kochi
summary: 1,800 port Cat6A and OM4 fibre cabling with full Fluke certification for a financial services tenant.
description: Structured cabling for a financial services tenant fitting out a new data hall. Every port was tested, labelled and handed over with Fluke certification reports, with the entire build completed inside the tenant's tight cutover window.

title: Campus Surveillance, 240 IP Cameras
summary: Campus wide IP CCTV deployment with central NVR, structured backbone and PoE switching across 12 buildings.
description: Twelve building campus surveillance rollout, with PoE switching, structured cabling backbone, central NVR and remote monitoring access for the security control room. The same team handled cabling and CCTV, which kept the schedule clean.

title: IT Hardware Refresh, Hospital Group
summary: Tier one OEM hardware refresh across 6 hospital sites covering endpoints, networking, server racks and asset tagged delivery.
description: A staggered hardware refresh across six hospital sites without disrupting clinical operations. We coordinated with the hospital IT team to deliver, image and tag endpoints on a per ward schedule, with all old assets returned for secure disposal.
